JM_DASH_CONFIG_MISSING: The Jim & Matt dashboard page id (JM_DASHBOARD_PAGE_ID) is not set.
JM_DASH_LAYOUT_MISSING: A Jim & Matt dashboard child (Weekly Check-ins, Quarterly QBR Records, Completed Archive, Matt's MegIBOW table) is missing or renamed.
JM_DASH_LAYOUT_AMBIGUOUS: Two children of the Jim & Matt dashboard carry the same machine title.
Rename or archive the extra one.
JM_DASH_DATABASE_SHAPE: A Jim & Matt dashboard database does not have exactly one data source.
JM_DASH_TOO_MANY_BLOCKS: A Jim & Matt dashboard page has more blocks than one run reads.
JM_DASH_TOO_MANY_ROWS: A Jim & Matt dashboard table has more rows than one run reads.
JM_DASH_APPEND_MISMATCH: Notion did not confirm every block appended to a dashboard page.
None; the next run rebuilds it.
JM_DASH_JIRA_BAD_PAGE: Jira's search answered in an unexpected shape.
JM_DASH_JIRA_TOO_MANY_PAGES: A Jira search for the dashboard matched more issues than one run reads.
JM_DASH_FAILED: The Jim & Matt dashboard run failed for an unexpected reason.
Read the run log (counts and codes only).
JM_DASH_KEYERROR: The Jim & Matt dashboard met a record without a field it needs.
Read the run log (counts and codes only).
JM_DASH_VALUEERROR: The Jim & Matt dashboard met a value it could not read.
Read the run log (counts and codes only).
JM_DASH_TYPEERROR: The Jim & Matt dashboard met a record of an unexpected type.
Read the run log (counts and codes only).
JIRA_ACTIVE_AMBIGUOUS: More than one active sprint was found on the board.
JIRA_BOARD_NOT_SCRUM: The configured board is not a Scrum board.
JIRA_CARD_APPEND_MISMATCH: Blocks appended to the Jira card did not read back as written.
Check the page; retried next run.
JIRA_CARD_CONFIG_INVALID: The Jira card configuration is not valid.
JIRA_CARD_CONFIG_MISSING: The Jira card configuration is missing.
JIRA_CARD_NOT_OWNED: The Jira card block is not one V7 owns, so nothing is changed.
None; the card never edits what it does not own.
JIRA_CARD_NO_SNAPSHOT: No Jira snapshot is stored yet for the card.
None; the snapshot stage runs first.
JIRA_CARD_STALE_NO_BASELINE: The snapshot is stale and V7 has not written this card yet, so there is nothing known-good to keep showing.
JIRA_CARD_TOO_MANY_BLOCKS: The rendered card has more blocks than Notion accepts in one call.
JIRA_CARD_VERIFY_FAILED: The Jira card did not read back as written.
JIRA_CARRY_VERIFY_FAILED: Carried issues did not show in the new sprint yet; Jira reads can lag. Nothing was closed.
JIRA_CATCHUP_FAILED: The catch-up rollover step could not be verified.
JIRA_CLOSE_VERIFY_FAILED: The old sprint did not show as closed.
JIRA_EARLY_ROLLOVER: The rollover was asked before the sprint's end.
JIRA_ERROR: An unnamed Jira error; the board position is appended.
JIRA_FINAL_VERIFY_FAILED: The rollover's final check did not match.
JIRA_NOT_MONDAY: The rollover only runs on Mondays.
JIRA_NO_END_DATE: The active sprint has no end date.
JIRA_NO_ROLLOVER_CANDIDATE: There is no sprint to roll over.
JIRA_START_VERIFY_FAILED: The new sprint did not show as active.
JIRA_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS: More than one future sprint could be the target.
JIRA_TARGET_NOT_FUTURE: The target sprint is not a future sprint.
JIRA_TARGET_NOT_STAGED: The next two-week sprint is missing from the approved roadmap.
Plan the next sprint in Jira before enabling rollover.
JIRA_UNSUPPORTED_CADENCE: The sprint dates do not define a Monday-Sunday 7- or 14-day window.
Correct the sprint dates in Jira.
